קב.ja: ע"ס וירא אלהים את כל אשר עשה והנה טוב מאד, יריד בה והנה טוב מות.
קב.en: Our early ones (peace be upon them) said: "And God saw all that He had made, and behold it was very good" — He means by this: behold, death is good.

pairs.en: Our early ones (peace be upon them)

pairs.ja: וירא אלהים את כל אשר עשה
pairs.en: And God saw all that He had made
and behold it was very good
He means by this
behold, death is good

קב.ja: וקאל אלחכים ושבח אני את המתים שכבר מתו מן החיים אשר המה חיים עדנה.
קב.en: And the Wise One said: "I praised the dead who are already dead, more than the living who are still living."

pairs.en: And the Wise One said
I praised the dead
who are already dead
more than the living
who are still living

קב.ja: ואלצ'רב אלת'אלת' מן את'אר אלחכמה צ'אהרה פי ג'הה וכ'פיה פי ג'הה אכ'רי, פלא ימייז ענהא אלקליל אלפהם אלא בעד אלתת'בת פיהא ואלתקצי עליהא,
קב.en: The third kind of the traces of wisdom is manifest in one aspect and hidden in another aspect, so that the man of little understanding cannot discern it except after careful examination of it and full inquiry into it,

pairs.en: The third kind
of the traces of wisdom
is manifest in one aspect
and hidden in another aspect
so that the man of little understanding cannot discern it
the man of little understanding
except after careful examination of it
and full inquiry into it

קב.ja: כאכ'תלאף אלעאם פי אחואלה פי אלפצול אלארבעה מנה ומא אשבה ד'לך,
קב.en: such as the variation of the year in its conditions through its four seasons, and the like of that.

pairs.en: such as the variation of the year
in its conditions
through its four seasons
and the like of that

קב.ja: פאלחאד'ק אלפטן יסתכ'לץ מן אלעאלם עלם רוחאניתה ולטאיפה, ויג'עלהא סלמא אלי אלאסתדלאל עלי כ'אלק אלכל תעאלי,
קב.en: The skillful, discerning man extracts from the world the knowledge of its spiritual realities and its subtleties, and makes them a ladder to the inference of the Creator of all (may He be exalted),

pairs.en: The skillful, discerning man
extracts from the world
the knowledge of its spiritual realities and its subtleties
and makes them a ladder
to the inference of the Creator of all
may He be exalted

קב.ja: פילזם נפסה טאעתה ועבאדתה בחסב ג'לאלתה ועט'מתה פי קלבה,
קב.en: so he binds himself to His obedience and His worship according to the measure of His majesty and His greatness in his heart,

pairs.en: so he binds himself
to His obedience and His worship
according to the measure of His majesty and His greatness
in his heart

קב.ja: ובקדר תמייזה לאת'אר ענאיתה ולטפה בג'מלהֵ מכ'לוקאתה, ותפצ'ילה איאה בג'זיל אלנעם, ותשריפה עליהא מן גיר עמל תקדם לה ולא פצ'ילה סבקת מנה אסתוג'ב בהא ג'מיל צנע אללה תעאלי.
קב.en: and in proportion to his discernment of the traces of His providence and His gentleness toward the totality of His creatures, and His favoring of him with abundant blessings, and His exalting of him above them — without any deed preceding from him, nor any merit prior from him, by which he would have deserved the goodly handiwork of God (may He be exalted).

pairs.en: and in proportion to his discernment
of the traces of His providence and His gentleness
toward the totality of His creatures
and His favoring of him
with abundant blessings
and His exalting of him above them
without any deed preceding from him
nor any merit prior from him
by which he would have deserved
the goodly handiwork of God (may He be exalted)

קב.ja: ת'ם יסתכ'לץ מן ג'סמאניהֵ אלעאלם מא פיה מנפעהֵ ג'סמה וקואם חאלה פי אלדניא חסב אלחאג'ה ואלבלגה פקט,
קב.en: Then he extracts from the corporeal part of the world only what contains the benefit of his body and the sustenance of his condition in this world, according to need and sufficiency alone,

pairs.en: Then he extracts
from the corporeal part of the world
what contains the benefit of his body
and the sustenance of his condition in this world
according to need and sufficiency alone

קב.ja: ויד'ר סאיר פצ'ול אלדניא וזכ'ארפהא אלשאגלה אלקלוב ען אללה עז וג'ל,
קב.en: and he abandons the rest of the superfluities of this world and its adornments that distract hearts from God (mighty and exalted),

pairs.en: and he abandons
the rest of the superfluities of this world
and its adornments
that distract hearts
from God (mighty and exalted)

קב.ja: ויג'תהד פי עמלה לאכ'רתה ומא יציר אליה בעד מותה,
קב.en: and he strives in his work for his afterlife and for that to which he will come after his death,

pairs.en: and he strives in his work
for his afterlife
and for that to which he will come
after his death

קב.ja: ויעתקד אלדניא ומתאעהא בלאגא וזאדא למעאדה ואכ'רתה, פהו יאכ'ד' מנהא מא יצח בה ענד רחילה ענהא פקט.
קב.en: and he regards this world and its goods as a provision and a viaticum for his return and his afterlife, so he takes from it only what will serve him well at his departure from it.

pairs.en: and he regards this world and its goods
as a provision and a viaticum
for his return and his afterlife
so he takes from it
only what will serve him well
at his departure from it

קב.ja: ואלג'אהל באלדניא ובאת'אר אלחכמה פיהא יג'עלהא דאר כ'לודה ומאואה, פיסעי להא ג'הדה, ויצרף אליהא ג'מיע ענאיתה וכדה, ט'נא אנה יג'רי פי מצלחהֵ נפסה, ולא ישער אן כדה ופצ'ל ג'מעה פיהא צאיר אלי
קב.en: But the ignorant man, ignorant of this world and of the traces of wisdom within it, makes it the abode of his eternity and his dwelling-place, so he labors for it to the utmost of his power, and he directs to it all his concern and his toil, supposing that he is acting for the welfare of his own self, yet he does not perceive that his toil and the surplus of what he amasses in it is destined to —

pairs.en: But the ignorant man, ignorant of this world
and of the traces of wisdom within it
makes it the abode of his eternity and his dwelling-place
so he labors for it to the utmost of his power
and he directs to it all his concern and his toil
